notes.title: Halloween possesses Manning Manor with a new Update! 🎃
notes.notes:
Spooky greetings everyone! Halloween is around the corner, and Manning Manor got possessed by the ghosts of "All Hallows' Eve". Maybe a certain Jack O'Lantern hides inside the not so abandoned mansion as well... So update Silver Chains and enter Manning Manor, if you dare!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34364455/211e9338d5fc4cf51f96e2531928d2737cf410c7.jpg

Silver Chains is part of the Steam Halloween Sale taking place from today! So, if you haven't spent Mommy a visit yet, you should definitely do it with 25% OFF! Or Mommy would be really mad at you...

👻 Happy Halloween to the world! 🎃

notes.title: Silver Chains Update #2 incl. Trading Cards Is Live!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34364455/2fb51e8a96df4675090483b0d9da1304bb7bf728.jpg

Hello everyone, we are very happy to announce that we have added Steam Trading Cards to the game! You can now collect trading cards, profile backgrounds, badges and emoticons while playing Silver Chains.

We have also made some small improvements to the game:

Fixed an issue with the SteamVR
Fixed another bug related to the statue heads

We will of course keep you posted on our next steps and updates. Thank you all!
Team Cracked Heads Games & Headup

notes.title: First Silver Chains Update Is Live!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34364455/21cd2b5d63f54f5479106e1189eceedb56355afb.jpg

To our amazing community! First of all, we’d like to say thank you for the great feedback and all the input you provided us with throughout the past 24 hours. That said, we are taking the community’s feedback very seriously and work very hard to improve your experiences!

Here is a short overview on the improvements that come with our first update:

 We have fixed an issue with the statue head (It now correctly disappears after using it)
 When in the attic, some players did not notice the aconite laying on the book, the exit is now closed until the aconite has been collected
 In the final battle, we decided to change the coloring of the amulets when players look through the monocle so that the amulets and important objects stand out from the interior


We will of course keep you posted on our next steps and updates. Thank you all!

Team Cracked Heads Games & Headup
